name: Tanjoubi ~Kayoizuma (Jishou) Nikki~
original_name: 誕生日～通い妻（自称）日記～
source:
Main heroine is a lively student who looks up to her painter older brother. But as her body matures, she starts to have strange dreams about her brother while body begins to feel weird.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角是一位崇拜画家哥哥的活泼学生。但随着她的身体逐渐成熟，她开始对哥哥做奇怪的梦，同时身体也开始感觉怪异。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
